settings.name: PUBLIC_BASE_URL
settings.description: The address people open, like https://sites.example.com: its own registrable domain, never a subdomain of the company's main one. Every site is served at <site>.<owner>.<host>.

settings.name: SECURE_MODE
settings.description: true requires HTTPS for PUBLIC_BASE_URL and a separate redirect port. Every real install sets it.

settings.name: PORT
settings.description: The port the server listens on.

settings.name: HTTPS_REDIRECT_PORT
settings.description: The port that redirects plain HTTP to HTTPS. Must differ from PORT with SECURE_MODE.

settings.name: TRUSTED_PROXY_CIDRS
settings.description: The proxies in front of the server (the ingress controller's pods), so the client address comes from X-Forwarded-For. Empty trusts none.

settings.name: OWNER_CERTS
settings.description: auto: each owner's sites move to their own hosts once the owner-hosts reconciler has their certificate. manual: you issue those certificates yourself.

settings.name: OWNER_CERT_ISSUER
settings.description: The cert-manager ClusterIssuer that signs each owner's *.<owner>.<host> certificate (an internal CA, or ACME with DNS-01). Needed by the reconciler.

settings.name: OWNER_INGRESS_TEMPLATE
settings.description: The install's own Ingress, which each owner's Ingress copies its class and annotations from.

settings.name: OWNER_HOSTS_INTERVAL
settings.description: How often the reconciler applies owner Ingresses and records certificate readiness.

settings.name: RESERVED_LABELS
settings.description: Extra hostnames (comma-separated) no person or team may take as a name, on top of the built-in ones.

settings.name: OIDC_ISSUER
settings.description: Your identity provider's issuer URL (Okta, Entra ID tenant, Google, Keycloak, ...). People sign in only through it.

settings.name: OIDC_CLIENT_ID
settings.description: The OIDC client ID registered for this install.

settings.name: OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET
settings.description: The OIDC client secret.

settings.name: OIDC_SCOPES
settings.description: Scopes asked for at sign-in, space-separated.

settings.name: OIDC_EMAIL_CLAIM
settings.description: The ID token claim read as the person's email address. The provider must vouch that it is verified.

settings.name: OIDC_USERNAME_CLAIM
settings.description: A claim to derive usernames from. Empty: the part of the email before the @.

settings.name: OIDC_ADMIN_CLAIM
settings.description: A claim that makes someone an admin when it holds OIDC_ADMIN_VALUE. Set both or neither.

settings.name: OIDC_ADMIN_VALUE
settings.description: The value of OIDC_ADMIN_CLAIM that makes someone an admin.

settings.name: OIDC_INSECURE_ALLOWED
settings.description: Allows a plain-HTTP identity provider. Local evaluation only; never on a real install.

settings.name: ADMIN_EMAILS
settings.description: Admins' email addresses, comma-separated. Removing one demotes them on the next deploy.

settings.name: ALLOWED_EMAIL_DOMAINS
settings.description: Email domains that may sign in, comma-separated. Required with Google, where anyone has an account.

settings.name: OIDC_HINT_DOMAIN
settings.description: The domain hint sent to the provider, to narrow its account chooser. It never authorizes anyone.

settings.name: OAUTH_REDIRECT_HOSTS
settings.description: Where an AI app connecting to /mcp may be sent back after sign-in, comma-separated.

settings.name: SESSION_SIGNING_KEY
settings.description: Signs the sign-in cookie: one or two <id>:<base64 32-byte key> entries, the first signing. Generate with echo "k1:$(openssl rand -base64 32)".

settings.name: SESSION_TTL
settings.description: How long a sign-in lasts, however active. Match your identity provider's session policy.

settings.name: SESSION_IDLE
settings.description: How long a sign-in survives unused. Not longer than SESSION_TTL.

settings.name: OAUTH_ACCESS_TTL
settings.description: How long an AI app's access token works before it refreshes.

settings.name: OAUTH_REFRESH_TTL
settings.description: How long an AI app stays connected before the person signs in at the identity provider again.

settings.name: API_KEY_MAX_DAYS
settings.description: The longest lifetime an API key (for CI and automation) may be minted with.

settings.name: API_KEY_DEFAULT_DAYS
settings.description: A new API key's lifetime when none is asked for. At most API_KEY_MAX_DAYS.

settings.name: API_KEY_EXPIRY_WARNING_DAYS
settings.description: A key this close to expiry shows "expires soon" and warns on every call.

settings.name: RATE_LIMIT_AUTH_CLIENT
settings.description: Sign-in, the session hand-off and AI app authorization, per client address (counted across replicas).

settings.name: RATE_LIMIT_AUTH_EMAIL
settings.description: Sign-in attempts per email address.

settings.name: RATE_LIMIT_API_KEY_MINT
settings.description: API keys minted per person (counted across replicas).

settings.name: RATE_LIMIT_OAUTH_REGISTER
settings.description: AI app registrations per client address (counted across replicas).

settings.name: RATE_LIMIT_OAUTH_TOKEN
settings.description: AI app token requests per client address (counted across replicas).

settings.name: NETWORK_ACCESS_APPROVALS
settings.description: How many different admins must approve opening a site to the network (no sign-in).

settings.name: MAX_TEAMS_PER_PERSON
settings.description: Teams one person may belong to before they can create another.

settings.name: MAX_TEAM_MEMBERS
settings.description: Members of one team, pending ones included.

settings.name: MAX_SITE_VIEWERS
settings.description: People and teams on one site's viewer list.

settings.name: ACCESS_LOG_VISIBILITY
settings.description: What a site's owner sees of its visits: counts (views and distinct viewers), owner (each visit and who), or admin (nothing; admins only).

settings.name: RATE_LIMIT_ADMIN_CLIENT
settings.description: Admin actions per client address.

settings.name: RATE_LIMIT_ADMIN_IDENTITY
settings.description: Admin actions per admin.

settings.name: MAX_ARCHIVE_BYTES
settings.description: The largest archive one deploy may send. Raise the ingress body-size limit with it.

settings.name: MAX_FILES_PER_SITE
settings.description: Files one deploy may hold.

settings.name: UPLOAD_CONCURRENCY
settings.description: Uploads (and, separately, downloads) one replica processes at once. Raise the pod's memory with it.

settings.name: QUOTA_MAX_SITES
settings.description: Sites one person or team may have. 0 is unlimited.

settings.name: QUOTA_MAX_BYTES
settings.description: Storage one person or team may use, every kept version and uploaded file included. 0 is unlimited.

settings.name: QUOTA_MAX_VERSIONS
settings.description: Versions kept per site; older ones are removed after each deploy.

settings.name: PREVIEW_LINK_TTL
settings.description: How long a preview link to a kept version works.

settings.name: EXPORT_LINK_TTL
settings.description: How long a whole-site download link works (once).

settings.name: CLAMD_ADDR
settings.description: A clamd scanner (host:port) that checks every uploaded file before it is stored. A scanner that is down refuses uploads.

settings.name: CLAMD_TIMEOUT
settings.description: How long the scan of one file may take.

settings.name: ASSET_MAX_FILE_BYTES
settings.description: The largest file a page may upload.

settings.name: ASSET_MAX_SITE_BYTES
settings.description: Uploaded files one site may hold, in bytes.

settings.name: ASSET_MAX_SITE_COUNT
settings.description: Uploaded files one site may hold.

settings.name: SEARCH_SESSION_MAX_AGE
settings.description: Lifetime of the anonymous cookie site search uses for its limits and counts.

settings.name: RATE_LIMIT_MANAGEMENT_CLIENT
settings.description: Management API calls per client address.

settings.name: RATE_LIMIT_MANAGEMENT_USER
settings.description: Management changes per person.

settings.name: RATE_LIMIT_SEARCH_QUERY_PEER
settings.description: Site searches per network peer.

settings.name: RATE_LIMIT_SEARCH_QUERY_SESSION
settings.description: Site searches per search session.

settings.name: RATE_LIMIT_STATE_CLIENT
settings.description: Saved-data writes per client.

settings.name: RATE_LIMIT_STATE_SITE
settings.description: Saved-data writes per site.

settings.name: RATE_LIMIT_STATE_READ_CLIENT
settings.description: Saved-data reads per client.

settings.name: RATE_LIMIT_STATE_READ_SITE
settings.description: Saved-data reads per site.

settings.name: DELETED_RETENTION_DAYS
settings.description: How long a deleted site stays restorable in Recently deleted. Keep the bucket's old-version retention at least this long.

settings.name: IDLE_CLEANUP_DAYS
settings.description: Idle cleanup: a site nobody opened, deployed to or saved to for this many days is marked. 0 turns it off; otherwise at least 30.

settings.name: IDLE_CLEANUP_GRACE_DAYS
settings.description: Idle cleanup: how long a marked site waits before it moves to Recently deleted.

settings.name: IDLE_CLEANUP_MAX_EMAILS
settings.description: Idle cleanup: sites one hourly run marks and emails about. 0 is no limit.

settings.name: AUDIT_RETENTION_DAYS
settings.description: How long the audit log is kept.

settings.name: ACCESS_LOG_RETENTION_DAYS
settings.description: How long the access log, and ended sessions with their IP and browser, are kept.

settings.name: SEARCH_TELEMETRY_RETENTION_DAYS
settings.description: How long search queries and clicks are kept.

settings.name: SMTP_URL
settings.description: Your mail relay, smtp://user:password@host:587 (STARTTLS) or smtps://host:465. It carries a password, so it goes in the Secret.

settings.name: SMTP_FROM
settings.description: The sender, like Simple Host <hosting@example.com>. Required with SMTP_URL.

settings.name: DB_HOST
settings.description: Your managed Postgres host. Or give DB_DSN instead of the parts.

settings.name: DB_PORT
settings.description: Its port.

settings.name: DB_NAME
settings.description: The database name.

settings.name: DB_USER
settings.description: The owning role the migrate and prune jobs connect as.

settings.name: DB_PASSWORD
settings.description: The owning role's password. Never the same as DB_APP_PASSWORD.

settings.name: DB_APP_USER
settings.description: The least-privilege role the server connects as (the manifest sets simplehost_app).

settings.name: DB_APP_PASSWORD
settings.description: That role's password; migrate sets it on every run.

settings.name: DB_DSN
settings.description: A complete postgres:// URL, instead of the parts above.

settings.name: DB_SSLMODE
settings.description: TLS to the database. Anything but verify-full needs DB_INSECURE_ALLOWED.

settings.name: DB_SSL_ROOT_CERT
settings.description: The database's CA bundle, mounted from the simple-host-db-ca Secret.

settings.name: DB_INSECURE_ALLOWED
settings.description: Allows a database without verified TLS. Local evaluation only.

settings.name: DB_INCLUSTER_EVALUATION
settings.description: Set by the in-cluster evaluation Postgres, which nothing backs up; logs a warning at every start. Never set it on a real install: it marks the database as throwaway.

settings.name: BACKUP_STORAGE_ENDPOINT
settings.description: The S3-compatible bucket's endpoint, over HTTPS.

settings.name: BACKUP_STORAGE_REGION
settings.description: The bucket's region, where the provider needs one.

settings.name: BACKUP_STORAGE_BUCKET
settings.description: The bucket that stores every site. Turn its versioning on.

settings.name: BACKUP_STORAGE_PREFIX
settings.description: The folder inside the bucket.

settings.name: BACKUP_STORAGE_ACCESS_KEY_ID
settings.description: The bucket's access key. Leave both keys out when a workload identity supplies credentials.

settings.name: BACKUP_STORAGE_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
settings.description: The bucket's secret key.

settings.name: BACKUP_STORAGE_INSECURE_ALLOWED
settings.description: Allows a plain-HTTP bucket endpoint. Local evaluation only.

settings.name: BACKUP_SSE
settings.description: Server-side encryption on every stored object.

settings.name: BACKUP_SSE_KEY_ID
settings.description: The KMS key, with BACKUP_SSE=aws:kms.

settings.name: BACKUP_ENVELOPE_KEY
settings.description: Optional encryption of every object before it leaves the pod: <id>:<base64 32-byte key> entries. Escrow it: sites are unreadable without it.

settings.name: BACKUP_ENVELOPE_PLAINTEXT_ALLOWED
settings.description: Keeps reading objects written before the envelope key was added, until reencrypt has covered them.

settings.name: CACHE_DIR
settings.description: The pod-local cache of site versions, emptied on start.

settings.name: CACHE_MAX_BYTES
settings.description: Size of that cache. Size its volume at about three times this.

settings.name: METRICS_PORT
settings.description: The port of the separate /metrics listener (Prometheus); not exposed by the Service or Ingress.
